process_policy: The 24-hour adapter was loaded first; the 168-hour adapter was loaded in the same process after deleting the first wrapper, so framework and base-model caches remained warm.
decision: Keep both adapters as production-eligible challengers, but retain the deployed TFTs until a shared-base multi-adapter loader, 672-hour readiness migration, and container memory gate pass.
month_release_effect: The month capability already pays the first Chronos base-model memory cost because it fills a previously missing product horizon. Replacing both lightweight TFTs would add adapter/model state for a marginal 2.6-2.9% London-cohort MAE gain.
